Noemi Alvarez: hey everyone! i'm noemi, starting today as a solutions engineer (she/her). SF-based, mostly hybrid — i'll be in the office Tue/Thu. small bio: commute by bike, make terrible latte art, and i collect vintage enamel pins. excited to join the crew! :bicyclist:
Theo: welcome Noemi!! bike commutes are the best. what's your route? there's a bike rack with covered spots near the loading dock. we'll save a spot.
Sam: hi Noemi — welcome! we have a bike club rideshare thread, ping me for safety lights and emergency snack committee. also the enamel-pin exchange is real.
Ben (IT): Noemi — badge/email/provisioning done. You'll get an email for badge pickup. If you need a locker for helmet and gear, reply here and I'll reserve one (space is limited). Also, standing desk? reply "stand" to request.
Noemi Alvarez: thanks Ben! please reserve a locker if available. and yes to a stand if possible.
plants-bot: Plant adoption day Friday at lunch! Reaction to claim: :seedling: . Current list: ZZ plant, small monstera, string of pearls.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for Noemi Alvarez — badge_assigned, welcome_message_sent.
Theo: also FYI there's a boba run group after 3pm near the lobby every Wednesday. if you're into taro or brown sugar, we usually coordinate orders.
Noemi Alvarez: brown sugar boba is my kryptonite — count me in. also anyone up for a pin swap on Thursday? i can bring a few enamel trinkets.
Sam: :thumbsup: see you Thursday. welcome aboard Noemi — can't wait to try your latte art (and the bike routes).
